new_value: {"notes":"2026-10-17 investigation: DR-15 premise wrong (ext-10 §5 L885-911 defines leaf safe_aad = supported Safe AAD components; GC safe_aad = required). No MUST broken today (§4.6 requires understanding, not advertising). Gaps: (1) leaf never advertises safe_aad (identity.rs:188-207); (2) no check of leaf lists vs GC required list anywhere (OpenMLS only toggles framing); (3) Member::create doesn't strictly decode GC safe_aad/app_components. Recommended corrected decision: reading B (always advertise; enforce like RFC 9420 §11.1; absent=empty; check in mimi-mls). Oracle: hand-encoded ComponentsList in key_package_mls_rs.rs; mls-rs-built KeyPackages with/without safe_aad against required [0x0020]. wg item filed."}
